decisions.why: the division's 14 captured products are Kyphon bone cement (KYPHON Xpede, Kyphon VuE = ortho:cement); Kyphon vertebroplasty/kyphoplasty delivery platforms and the OsteoCool radiofrequency ablation system (ortho:equip); allograft bone/tendon products (Frozen Anterior Tibialis Tendon, Frozen Semi-T tendons, Tendons & Ligaments, OrthoBlast II, Accell Connexus Putty, Allograft Cancellous Bone, TOPS System = implant biologics, ortho:implant); and Jazz Posterior Fixation (spinal fixation hardware, ortho:trauma). Awarded on Total Orthopaedic Solutions 3.
